story.iWant: a CLI interface with export capabilities for the scraping library
story.soThat: I can easily scrape websites and export data to JSON/CSV formats from the command line
story.tasks: - [ ] Set up CLI framework with Commander.js (AC: 1, 5) - [ ] Initialize CLI project structure per tech-spec - [ ] Configure Commander.js for command parsing - [ ] Implement basic scrape command with URL parameter - [ ] Add output format options (JSON, CSV) - [ ] Add configuration file support flag - [ ] Implement CLI commands structure (AC: 1, 2) - [ ] Create main CLI entry point at src/cli/index.ts - [ ] Implement scrape command at src/cli/commands/scrape.ts - [ ] Implement config command at src/cli/commands/config.ts - [ ] Implement validate command at src/cli/commands/validate.ts - [ ] Add CLI utility functions at src/cli/utils/ - [ ] Create export functionality with JSON support (AC: 3) - [ ] Implement JSON exporter at src/exporters/json.ts - [ ] Add data transformation and formatting - [ ] Create file output with proper naming - [ ] Add validation for JSON output format - [ ] Implement CSV export functionality (AC: 4) - [ ] Create CSV exporter at src/exporters/csv.ts - [ ] Handle data serialization to CSV format - [ ] Add proper header and row formatting - [ ] Implement file writing and error handling - [ ] Add database integration interface (AC: 3, 4) - [ ] Create database exporter at src/exporters/database.ts - [ ] Support SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL connections - [ ] Implement table creation and data insertion - [ ] Add connection management and error handling - [ ] Implement error handling and user feedback (AC: 5) - [ ] Add structured error messages for CLI users - [ ] Implement progress indicators and status updates - [ ] Create logging utilities for CLI operations - [ ] Add graceful error recovery and exit codes - [ ] Create executable CLI script (AC: 1) - [ ] Create bin/docs-scrape executable script - [ ] Configure package.json for CLI distribution - [ ] Add shebang and permissions setup - [ ] Test CLI installation and execution - [ ] Write unit tests for CLI functionality (AC: 6) - [ ] Test CLI command parsing and validation - [ ] Test export functionality for JSON and CSV - [ ] Test error handling and user feedback - [ ] Test configuration file loading and validation - [ ] Write integration tests for end-to-end CLI scenarios (AC: 6) - [ ] Test complete CLI scraping workflows - [ ] Test configuration-driven CLI scraping - [ ] Test export formats and file generation - [ ] Test error scenarios in realistic contexts - [ ] Configure CLI testing patterns following existing standards (AC: 6) - [ ] Apply Test ID Conventions (TC-CLI-001 format) to all CLI tests - [ ] Implement Priority Classification (P0-P3 markers) for test prioritization - [ ] Create fixture patterns for CLI testing scenarios - [ ] Ensure test isolation and cleanup for CLI operations

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. CLI framework accepts scrape commands with URL and output parameters 2. Configuration file support enables complex scraping scenarios via YAML/JSON 3. JSON export functionality outputs structured data correctly 4. CSV export functionality creates properly formatted spreadsheets 5. Error handling provides clear user feedback for failures 6. CLI tool is fully tested with comprehensive test coverage
